notes.title: Rhythmetallic Update #13 - Metal Reforged
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40828708/b569d554874ed7e4dc07f0b204bf67fe48e0240d.png[/img]

Rhythmetallic Update 13 - Metal Reforged
v2.13.0

Introducing multiple difficulties!

Based on player feedback, we have implemented a new feature to accommodate players with different skill levels. Moving forward, certain songs will offer multiple charts with varying difficulties. This means that challenging songs will now have an easier version for players to start with, while easier songs will have a more challenging version. We believe this addition will better cater to players with various skill levels. In future updates, we plan to include multiple difficulties for more songs.

- New Features: Multiple Difficulties
Metal Forge now offers alternative difficulties for 10 heavy metal songs.

notes.title: Rhythmetallic Update #11 - Trials of Ascension
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40828708/a7b5e22e8a0b3a19d617d06facd5735dadf35903.png[/img]

Get ready to experience an electrifying new way to play Rhythmetallic with the latest update v2.11.0! We're thrilled to introduce Arena Mode, a brand new game mode that will take your rhythm game skills to the next level!

In Arena Mode, you'll face off against other players in an epic metal battle, where you'll have to shred your way through challenging mutations of random songs. With challenges refreshed every week, you'll never get bored of playing the same old tracks.

Update 11 - Trials of Ascension
v2.11.0
- Add new game mode: Arena Mode
- Arena challenges are refreshed every week with random songs and mutations that change the gameplay.
